about: The schools of the islands, each from the year it opened to the year it closed or moved (DATA.md “Schools, dated”). A school that moved is a feature per site, sharing a group. Baked by tools/bake-schools.mjs from tools/lib/schools-table.json.

layers.layer: OpenStreetMap ways and relations tagged amenity=school, college or university, by id, through the Overpass API

sources.title: School Status and Improvement Reports
sources.author: Hawaiʻi State Department of Education, Office of Strategy, Innovation and Performance (ARCH)
sources.note: Fetched 2026-11-06 from the Department's report repository, one report per school for SY 1999–2000, 2004–05, 2009–10, 2014–15, 2018–19 and 2024–25; the first pages of each read for the school's description (the year it says it opened or was founded, and where it says it moved), its fall enrolment, and in 2024–25 its name as the Department writes it.
sources.wanted: For the schools whose descriptions give no year: the school's own history page, or the Department's school directory, for the year it opened.

sources.title: Royal School (Hawaii)

sources.title: The schools’ own pages (about, history)
sources.author: each school
sources.note: Each school’s home page and its about and history pages, from the website the State’s school layers give, fetched 2026-11-07; read for the year the school says it was founded, established or opened, and where it says it moved. Each citation’s where names the page read.
sources.wanted: For the schools whose pages give no year: the school’s own printed history, or the Department’s directories of the territory.

sources.title: Biennial Report of the President of the Board of Education to the Legislature of 1882
sources.author: Kingdom of Hawaiʻi, Board of Education
sources.note: Read 2026-11-07 in the University of Hawaiʻi’s eVols scan (its text layer): the summary of the select and independent schools, the list of the government common schools having 25 or more pupils by island and district, and the aided boarding and day schools. It gives each school’s place by village and district, its teacher and its pupils, not its site.
sources.wanted: The lists of the reports before and after (1856–1896, all in eVols) for each school’s first and last year; a Government Survey sheet that marks the schoolhouses, for their sites.

sources.title: Annual Report 2024–25

sources.wanted: For the converted schools: the year each school itself opened.

sources.wanted: The school’s site from 1865 to 1869 on Fort Street, and which corner of Beretania and Victoria it stood on.

sources.title: Insurance Maps of Honolulu, Territory of Hawaii (1914)
